chunks: 5. My father (may Allah have mercy on him) said: 'Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated to us, from his father, from Ibn Fuddal, from Abu Jamilah, from Muhammad al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
regarding the Word of Allah, the Mighty and High: 'The nature made by Allah is which He has made men.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'He created them with Divine Unity.'
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Fitrah in Shia theology according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Tawhid*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that the innate *fitrah* mentioned in Surah Ar-Rum is specifically the recognition of Divine Unity (*Tawhid*), establishing it as the primordial state of all humans. This interpretation underscores the Shia theological view that belief in one God is not merely a learned doctrine but an inherent, uncorrupted disposition embedded in human nature by the Creator.
